headline: Contested Fronts Register Fresh Base Movement
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the principal movement still confined to a small belt of contested sectors, with several changes since the last edition. Weathered Expanse has eased from 60 to 54 recorded base events in 24 hours, yet remains the busiest front, with four incidents in the latest two hours and Crow’s Nest leading the tally. Nevish Line has climbed from 35 to 43 daily events and now reports six in two hours, with Princefal, Grief Mother, and Blackcoat Way prominent. Marban Hollow has risen from 37 to 39 events, while Checkpoint Bua remains its chief trouble spot; the sector recorded none in the latest two hours. Kuura Strand has edged up from 29 to 33 daily events and has the freshest sustained activity, including three incidents in two hours around Faden Point. Linn Mercy has advanced from ten to 11 events, with five in the latest two hours at Lathair. Godcrofts holds at six daily events, though its recent six-hour record has cooled. Other sectors report fighting or enlistment without recorded base changes, and no victor is declared.
